one_liner: Xero has a broad REST accounting API with self-serve OAuth 2.0 app registration and a free Starter tier (5 connections); official MCP exists.
auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 authorization-code flow for multi-user apps (tenant list via /connections); Custom Connections is a machine-to-machine client-credentials option bound to one org. No API keys. OAuth 1.0a is deprecated.
access_notes: Free developer account and free Starter tier (5 connections, 1,000 calls/day/org). Higher tiers cost money. Some scopes (balance sheet, P&L, journals) for new apps need App Partner Program enrolment. Custom Connections are a paid add-on.
blocker_notes: Minor limits: the free Starter tier caps at 5 connections, and the reporting and journals scopes need partner enrolment. Xero's developer terms bar using API data to train AI models. None of these block building and testing.

evidence.quote: The Xero API does not support basic API Key authentication. Our API uses OAuth 2.0 which means you need to register your app to get a client id and client secret
OAuth 1.0a is in the process of being deprecated and OAuth 2.0 is required for all new integrations.
